title: TypeScript official and ecosystem references
notes: Version-sensitive claims use official release notes. The PDF supplies the intended syllabus; these references support factual explanations and current tooling behavior.

references.title: TypeScript Handbook
references.supports: Core language concepts, type system, practical TypeScript learning and official reference.

references.title: Everyday Types
references.supports: Primitive types, annotations, inference, arrays, unions, literals, any, assertions, and common types.

references.title: Narrowing
references.supports: Control-flow analysis, typeof, truthiness, equality checks, discriminated unions and never.

references.title: More on Functions
references.supports: Function annotations, callback types, overloads, generics, and function compatibility.

references.title: Object Types
references.supports: Object shapes, optional and readonly properties, interfaces, index signatures and type aliases.

references.title: Generics
references.supports: Type parameters, constraints, inference and reusable generic relationships.

references.title: Creating Types from Types
references.supports: Keyof, indexed access, conditional and mapped types, template literal types, and utility patterns.

references.title: Classes
references.supports: Class syntax, members, visibility, inheritance, abstract classes and class/runtime distinctions.

references.title: Modules: Introduction
references.supports: Module formats, resolution, package entry points, interoperability and compiler module settings.

references.title: TSConfig Reference
references.supports: Compiler options and project configuration including strictness, modules, output, libraries and references.

references.title: Announcing TypeScript 6.0
references.supports: TypeScript 6.0 bridge release, defaults, deprecated options and 6-to-7 migration.

references.title: Announcing TypeScript 7.0
references.supports: TypeScript 7.0 native Go implementation, compatibility scope and compiler/tooling transitions.

references.title: Declaration Files Introduction
references.supports: Declaration file structure, package typings, library development and maintenance.

references.title: JavaScript Modules Guide
references.supports: JavaScript module fundamentals and runtime import/export behavior.

references.title: Node.js TypeScript Support
references.supports: Node.js TypeScript execution support, runtime type stripping boundaries and version-specific behavior.

references.title: React TypeScript Guide
references.supports: Typing React props, hooks, events, forms, and JSX-oriented TypeScript examples.

references.title: Vitest Guide
references.supports: Unit testing, assertions, test doubles and test-runner workflows for JavaScript/TypeScript projects.

references.title: OWASP Top 10
references.supports: Web application threat categories, trust boundaries, injection prevention and secure handling of input.

references.title: npm Documentation
references.supports: Dependency installation, scripts, lockfiles, package metadata and publishing workflows.

references.title: TypeScript 6-to-7 migration context
references.supports: Official transition notes; tooling that needs the compiler API should follow the published compatibility guidance.
